integrity: Finite exact enumeration with two distinct integer evaluations, full 8192-frequency checksum, source-generated checker and replay output. Mathematical proof of nonvanishing modulo four is symbolic; the signed multiplicities are proved by a bounded exhaustive incidence census.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite spectrum of the 13-point ternary projective plane only. Historical-priority search is bounded; an unindexed equivalent signed-incidence census is possible. No all-field or all-order conclusion and no external independent audit.
title: Complete Walsh spectrum and sharp recovery for ternary projective-plane bases
